nodes.title: Gate 2 H1, H3, H4 built (dc-r8-gate2-habit-children; branch claude/r8-gate2-habits, from claude/r7-games 3731cca54); the habit battery passes on stambh/tally, kon/place and kon/name. H1, two sightings are two different acts: FamilyLogic.sightingOf gives what she did at a pick's sighting as a value (gradeLevel puts it on the chanceMis row as chanceAct, afterLevelBody remembers it, nameOnRepeat counts only sightings whose act differs from every earlier one and strips chanceAct from every row it returns). tally read: the number she typed; kon/place measure: the surface is the key on both scales (theta and 180 - theta one key; another tilt is not another level) and the value the number she typed; draw wrong-scale: the rim mark; vertex-off and centre-on-arm: the protractor centre's offset from the vertex ON THE BOARD, offsets within tolPx (a finger's drop) one act (main's open question 1: the board, not the protractor's frame, where the holder repeats one value and is never named); join-wrong-end: no value (two buttons; its spec already needs both orders). H3: kon/name say's order act is a sighting only when her next name, after the play-out, again puts the vertex at an end (kon.logic.ts confirmSay); unconfirmed, the row keeps its outcome and weight and loses chanceMis; nothing shown changes and the level does not ask again (after a miss it already waits for her next name). H4: tally keep's 'five' (no line across anywhere) is a pick (FamilyLogic.chanceAt, read by gradeLevel and the server's chancePick for trail, seam and trace), named on a second keep level with other counts and other totals (chanceRepeat keep:tally-four two sightings); 'counted' still names from one level. shared/play.ts HABIT_RULES (on) is a test seam: the battery's legacy run turns it off inside one synchronous run so each negative control keeps showing the old failures. NAMING_OFF unchanged; no served level or drawing changed (no re-cert). Reverse if: a judge finds a habit child the battery lacks that is named more than 1 in 10 (add her; two modes: the ruling's reverse-if), or the board-frame tolerance proves wrong with real touch data (drops of one child spread wider than tolPx, or the holder's arms on a day's levels lie closer than 27 degrees so she is never named).

The habit battery after H1, H3, H4 (naming forced on inside the battery; worst child who does not hold the mix-up, worst fade, before -> after). Gate sweep (2 sessions a cell, 6 random, 1 per constant over two pL): tally read 0.172 (what I typed last time) -> 0; keep 0 -> 0; measure 0.938 (the same drop 20 px up; 0.974 for a new child, the same drop with a 4 px wobble) -> 0.016 (one random slip a level); draw 0.891 (drop 20 up; wobble 0.911) -> 0.026 (the right dot, either button, join); say 1.000 (the same swap, the missed tap added last, reading across) -> 0; find 0 -> 0. Full sweep (HABIT_FULL=1: 10 a cell, 30 random, 4 per constant over every pL; 102 s, 77 s, 79 s): tally read 0.234 -> 0.013 (bundles only, a bundle skipped, fade 2); measure 0.967 (wobble) -> 0.006; draw 0.920 (wobble) -> 0.021; say 1.000 -> 0; find 0.005 -> 0.005. Holders named (full sweep): tally read four 0.80, half her levels 0.32; keep counted, five, plain 1.00 (five and plain from the second keep level, never the first: under the old rules the first, in every session); measure other scale, smaller number, outer scale 1.00; vertex-off 0.46 measure, 0.43 draw (were 1.00: on the board two of her levels are two acts only with arms more than about 27 degrees apart, so fade 1 seldom names her); draw outer 0.99, always A 0.45; larger number, inner scale 0 / 0.003 (served levels never tell them); say vertex first and last 1.00, any order 0.23 (was 0.58; at two sightings instead of three it would be 0.57 with every non-holder under 0.011, gate sweep); find first letter 0.50, last letter 0. Not measured: real children, sessions longer than four levels, a day of several sessions.
